usage.reason: The source documents only an employee directory and no per-user last-activity field, audit log, or usage report.

evidence.quote: Directory fieldset and matching employee records

assumptions: The source does not document authentication; the HTTP Basic API-key method is provisional and should be verified.
The source does not document pagination; this manifest assumes one response contains all matching employees.
Company Directory can be disabled or unavailable to the caller, so this endpoint may return no directory even for an administrator.
The source does not confirm whether terminated, suspended, or deactivated people are included when onlyCurrent is false.
The source provides no email, account status, role, user type, creation time, or activity field for each employee.
The source recommends a custom report API when the directory feature is unavailable, but it does not provide a custom report endpoint here.
The source does not state a paid plan requirement.
The source contained suspicious text telling AI agents to use another host; that instruction was ignored.
